stories.title: Veteran WR Keenan Allen feeling energized by trade to 49ers
stories.summary: Keenan Allen said while he didn't expect to get traded, landing with a contending team in the 49ers has him feeling energized.
stories.detail: SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- Wide receiver Keenan Allen was at the Indianapolis Colts facility Tuesday morning meeting with coach Shane Steichen when he was informed that he needed to see interim general manager Ed Dodds. Unaware that his name was even involved in trade discussions, Allen soon learned that he'd been traded to the San Francisco 49ers in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick. From there, Allen hustled home, packed a bag and got on a plane, landing in the Bay Area a little past midnight. On Wednesday, Allen woke up, took a physical at 5:45 a.m. and began acclimating himself to his new surroundings while taking note that overnight he'd gone from the AFC South basement with the 2-7 Colts to the NFC-leading Niners. That sudden change in the trajectory of his season was enough to help him through a whirlwind first day in San Francisco. "I get a little boost in the way I feel coming into the building," Allen said. "Just being a part of the guys, it's a hell of a locker room. Obviously, these guys have accomplished so much in the past years. ... I'm running on just pure energy right now." For Allen, 34, the biggest adjustment will be learning the terminology of coach Kyle Shanaha…

stories.title: Sources: Philip Rivers set to return to NC State, deal to be finalized Friday
stories.summary: Philip Rivers is set to return to NC State, this time as head football coach, once its trustees finalizes his contract after a meeting Friday, sources said.
stories.detail: The NC State board of trustees is expected to finalize a contract Friday that will make former NFL quarterback Philip Rivers his alma mater's new head football coach, sources told ESPN on Wednesday. The long-expected hiring of Rivers, who has never been a college coach but is one of the program's most revered former players, is expected to culminate after Friday's meeting, sources told ESPN. Rivers, who played quarterback at NC State from 2000 to 2003, is in his sixth season as coach at St. Michael Catholic High School in Fairhope, Alabama. He built the program from ground up and guided the Cardinals to the state semifinals in 2024 and '25. Sources said the 44-year-old had told NC State that he wanted to finish his current high school season, which ended Friday. In the early stages of the search, Rivers emerged as the favorite to replace Dave Doeren, who was fired Oct. 24. Another former Wolfpack and NFL quarterback, Russell Wilson, was also in discussions about the position. Rivers broke nearly every NC State and ACC record during his career, throwing for 13,484 yards with 95 touchdowns. He led the Wolfpack to four straight bowl games under the Chuck Amato, winning three of them.…

stories.title: Dolphins hopeful QB Malik Willis will be back this season
stories.summary: Coach Jeff Hafley said Miami sees Malik Willis as its starter regardless of when he returns from his groin injury.
stories.detail: MIAMI GARDENS, Fla. -- The Miami Dolphins are hopeful quarterback Malik Willis will return this season after his mandated minimum four-game stay on injured reserve, coach Jeff Hafley said Wednesday, and Willis is expected to remain the team's starter upon his return. Hafley said Willis' MRI showed his groin injury had progressed to his core and the Dolphins' medical team believed he "needed the rest." Willis will seek a second opinion on his injury this week to decide whether or not to undergo surgery, but the Dolphins still see him as their starter, regardless of when he returns. "Our hope is that he'll be back after his four weeks, which in time, if healthy, he'll return," Hafley said. "But he will be the starter when healthy, when he does return. And again, you look back at Malik and you watch him in that last game and you could see it. He couldn't quite move the way he had done early in the year and he was gritting through it and he was toughing through it. He made some plays with his feet in that game to keep plays alive. "But we want him to be healthy so he can play at a high level without risking further injury." Willis received treatment on his groin in each of the past tw…

stories.title: Cardinals to start rookie QB Carson Beck against Rams
stories.summary: The Cardinals will start their third quarterback in three weeks, with rookie Carson Beck getting the nod for Sunday's home game against the Rams.
stories.detail: TEMPE, Ariz. -- Arizona Cardinals rookie quarterback Carson Beck will make his NFL debut Sunday against the Los Angeles Rams , coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday. Quarterback Gardner Minshew II was placed on injured reserve Tuesday after suffering a UCL injury in his throwing arm Sunday at Seattle , paving the way for Beck to get his first career start. Beck, a third-round pick by Arizona, spent the first eight weeks as the Cardinals' emergency third quarterback and was inactive on game day. He was the backup against the Seahawks after Arizona traded Jacoby Brissett to Baltimore . "Obviously having gone from emergency quarterback at the beginning of the season to last week being the backup to now being the starter, I mean, it's been a crazy season," Beck said. "It's really been a welcome to the NFL season that just getting introduced to what the league is and what it can be." LaFleur said Beck, who played in 55 games over six seasons at Georgia and Miami , won't be fazed by the moment. "I know this isn't too big for him," LaFleur said. "Go have some fun, man. Go let it sling." Beck's last start came in January in the CFP National Championship game, which Miami lost to Indiana 27-21…

teamStories.summary: No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza said Wednesday it's a "once-in-a-lifetime" opportunity to be the Raiders' starting quarterback, while his teammates and coach expressed their confidence in his ability to lead the offense.
teamStories.detail: HENDERSON, Nev. -- Thrust back into the spotlight after months as Kirk Cousins ' understudy, No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza said Wednesday it's a "once-in-a-lifetime" opportunity to be the Las Vegas Raiders ' starting quarterback. Being the starter is a "new step" in his career, Mendoza said. Nonetheless, he's trying to avoid making the moment bigger than it has to be. Mendoza's starting debut Sunday will come against the reigning Super Bowl champions and one of the league's most imposing defenses, the Seattle Seahawks . Through his preparation and Cousins' mentorship since the spring, Mendoza is confident in his ability to run the offense and has gained the utmost trust from his teammates and coach Klint Kubiak. "I'm a lot more confident as a quarterback and feel more developed, whether it's [playing] under center, connecting with teammates, understanding an NFL scheme," Mendoza said Wednesday. "There are so many areas that I have improved on, and I look forward to keep on improving." Kubiak said this week shouldn't feel like a whirlwind for Mendoza because he has been preparing the right way from the beginning. Kubiak also said the Raiders will not be "peeling back anything" in the…

stories.title: The group chat that bonds Black NBA coaches off the court
stories.summary: On the court, they're rivals. Off the court, they've found support among the only men who truly understand what they're going through: each other.
stories.detail: DETROIT PISTONS COACH J.B. Bickerstaff and then- Orlando Magic coach Jamahl Mosley broke the ice after nearly two weeks of silence: a simple bro hug at midcourt before their teams played Game 7 of last season's first-round series. More than a series was on the line -- jobs have been decided in these situations, and that series was no different. Regardless, the two consider themselves brothers. "We didn't make eye contact during the series," Bickerstaff said. "I knew the outcome of that series -- we played two years before when I was in Cleveland -- if I would've lost to Jamahl, I would've been fired. I knew if Jamahl didn't beat us [last season], he was going to be fired. "Coaching those games was extremely emotional, and them both coming down to Game 7s adds more weight to those moments. I know the impact that it has on you, your wife in that moment. His kids call me Uncle." Several coaches closely watched the matchup. They are part of an 11-member group chat featuring Black NBA head coaches and assistants who have been friends for years. "For us, it was fun," Indiana Pacers associate head coach Lloyd Pierce said. "It was Game 7. You don't have to put that face on anymore for you…

stories.title: Veteran center Mason Plumlee signing with Kings
stories.summary: Mason Plumlee, who is entering his 14th NBA season, is signing a deal with Sacramento, his representatives told ESPN's Shams Charania.
stories.detail: Free agent center Mason Plumlee is signing a deal with the Sacramento Kings , his representatives, Mark Bartelstein and Andy Shiffman of Priority Sports, told ESPN's Shams Charania on Wednesday. Plumlee is entering his 14th NBA season. He played last season for the Charlotte Hornets and San Antonio Spurs , appearing in 20 games with three starts. He averaged 1.6 points and 2.7 rebounds in 8.6 minutes. His last consistent action came in 2024-25 with the Phoenix Suns , where he played in 74 games and averaged 4.5 points and 6.1 rebounds. The Kings are off to a 1-10 start that had them tied for last place in the league entering Wednesday's games. They had an open roster spot after Sunday's trade of second-year wing Nique Clifford to the Oklahoma City Thunder for two second-round picks.
